definitions.explanation: A feeling of care and concern for someone who is suffering or in difficulty. The warmth of human feeling that leads one to help others.
Romantic love or deep affection, especially in classical or literary contexts.

examples.japanese: {情|なさ}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れない→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
examples.english: I won't forget the person who showed me kindness.
Kindness is not (just) for others' sake. (proverb)
examples.notes: This proverb means that kindness eventually comes back to benefit you.

⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人目|ひとめ}→人目：17973_hitome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忍|しの}んで→忍ぶ：16953_shinobu⟧{情|なさ}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交|か}わした→交わす：19373_kawasu⟧。
examples.english: The two exchanged tender affection in secret.

examples.english: Thanks to the kindness of someone I met while traveling, I was able to make it home safely.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {情|なさ}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧ (to show compassion, to take pity on)
- ⟦{情|なさ}け{深|ぶか}い→情け深い：16074_nasakebukai⟧ (compassionate, tender-hearted)
- {情|なさ}け⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{為|ため}→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦なら→なる：01970_naru⟧ず (proverb: kindness you show comes back to you)

WATCH OUT ({情|なさ}けない):
⟦{情|なさ}けない→情けない：03129_nasakenai⟧ looks like the negative of {情|なさ}け, but it means "pathetic" or "shameful" — something that makes you ashamed.
- ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{情|なさ}けない→情けない：03129_nasakenai⟧ (I'm ashamed of myself)

USAGE:
{情|なさ}け is warm and human, suggesting genuine concern for someone in difficulty. Note that {情|なさ}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧ can also carry a note of condescension — pity from a position of strength — so it is not a neutral way to describe helping a peer.

RELATED WORDS (compounds with ⟦{情|じょう}→情：03343_jou⟧):
- ⟦{人情|にんじょう}→人情：11437_ninjou⟧ (human kindness, human feeling)
- ⟦{愛情|あいじょう}→愛情：01673_aijou⟧ (love, affection)
